method: Ground-truth validation functions were compared with read-only Phase 2.5 Quick input sources, function boundaries, compare candidates, flow traces and slices. No benchmark binary was executed.
limitations: Classification is a single-maintainer static review and remains subject to correction.
first_failed_edge identifies the earliest observed missing relationship, not every unsupported operation in the challenge.
Packed validation code that is absent from the original static image remains in Overall FN counts but is separately labeled.
